parts.name: spider center

physics.Basic_description: Central cross-shaped component of the universal joint, appearing as a matte grey metal block.
physics.Functional_description: Connects the two yokes and allows rotation between them.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp effectively without disassembly.
physics.reason: The spider is a load-bearing core component typically forged from solid steel.

parts.description: Central cross-shaped component of the universal joint, appearing as a matte grey metal block.
parts.function: Connects the two yokes and allows rotation between them.

parts.name: shaft yoke

physics.Basic_description: Large splined shaft with a forked end, matte grey metal finish.
physics.Functional_description: Transmits torque from one side and connects to the spider.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the splined shaft section firmly with parallel jaws.
physics.reason: Drive shafts and yokes in universal joints are typically solid or thick-walled to handle high torque; modeled as solid for mass estimation given small scale.

parts.name: cap pos

physics.Basic_description: Small cylindrical cap covering the bearing on the positive side of yoke A.
physics.Functional_description: Encloses the needle bearings and retains the spider journal.
physics.reason: Bearing caps are cup-shaped shells that house rollers, enclosing empty space.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
